parallels.note: Rejoice in that day, and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing…

translations.web: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.
translations.bsb: Rejoice and be glad, because great is your reward in heaven, for in the same way they persecuted the prophets before you.
translations.kjv: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
translations.asv: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets that were before you.
